I fixed the typo in `services/notifier/migrations/202609011200_create_outbox.sql`: the column `recipent` is now `recipient`. I didn't run any tests, and that line was the only occurrence in the repo.

I edited the file in place instead of adding a new migration. Two memories pointed in opposite directions:
- The general hazard says never edit an applied migration and add a new numbered file instead.
- The notifier-specific note says no notifier migration has been applied to a shared database, and that fixes should be made in place until launch, planned for 2026-11.

I followed the notifier note because it covers this directory and today is 2026-10-04, before launch. If this migration has in fact been applied somewhere shared, the edit won't reach that database and you'd need a follow-up migration that renames the column.

After launch, the in-place fix stops being safe, so the notifier note will go stale then.
